description:
📘 Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real Bible questions answered directly from Scripture. In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar answer two important Bible questions about personal responsibility, spiritual leadership, and Christian conduct toward others.

00:00 Intro

01:58 — What Does 1 Timothy 5:22 Mean?
Paul counsels Timothy not to be “hasty in the laying on of hands” and not to “share in the sins of others.”

What does this mean in context?
Is Paul referring to ordination and leadership responsibility?
Does it involve caution in endorsing others?
How can someone become partaker in another person’s sins without directly committing them?

19:00 — What Does “Heap Coals of Fire” Mean? (Proverbs 25:21–22)
This passage is often misunderstood. Does it refer to punishment, conviction, or something else?

The pastors examine the biblical meaning of:

Showing kindness to enemies
The purpose of “burning coals”
How this principle is applied in Christian life

📖 This episode explores:

1 Timothy 5:22 explained
Laying on of hands in the Bible
Sharing in the sins of others
Proverbs 25:21–22 meaning
Heaping coals of fire explained
Christian conduct toward enemies
Biblical leadership principles

💬 Have a Bible question? Leave it in the comments — it may be featured in a future episode.
